chain.title: Ketchup First
chain.desc: A tomato in the Food Core juicer. Extended's burgers, hot dogs and sandwiches ask for 'a condiment' - ketchup is the cheapest answer and unlocks that entire tag the moment your tomato farm exists.

chain.title: Grind Black Pepper
chain.desc: Peppercorns from the fruit-tree mod go through the grinder. Salt and pepper together form the saltandpepper spice tag that gourmet patties and steak dishes demand - stock both shakers.

chain.title: Ground Cinnamon
chain.desc: Cinnamon bark through the grinder. It sweetens rolls, toast and oatmeal, but its load-bearing job is curry powder later in this chain - grind extra.

chain.title: Peanut Butter
chain.desc: Peanuts through the grinder. The nut-butter of choice for cookies, PB&J and peanut butter cups - and the same grinder pattern also does almond, cashew and chestnut butter when you find those nuts.

chain.title: Mill Cornmeal
chain.desc: Corn through the grinder. Cornmeal is the gate into the entire Tex-Mex line: tortillas, chips, cornbread and corn dogs all start at this yellow powder.

chain.title: Press Tortillas
chain.desc: Cornmeal and water on the skillet. Tacos, burritos, chimichangas, quesadillas and tortilla chips all wrap in this - one of the highest fan-out intermediates in the mod.

chain.title: Fresh Salsa
chain.desc: Tomato, onion, spiceleaf, lime and garlic in the mixing bowl - five farms in one bowl. Eat it with chips or fold it into the burrito line; it proves your crop spread is complete.

chain.title: Taco Night
chain.desc: Cutting board, raw beef, lettuce, cheese, tortilla. The first full Tex-Mex plate - and the pattern for the fish taco, burrito and chimichanga variants beside it.

chain.title: Bake Biscuits
chain.desc: Dough and butter in the bakeware. A humble bake with an outsized future: chicken biscuits, BBQ chicken biscuits and the biscuits-and-gravy plate all stack on it.

chain.title: Make Gravy
chain.desc: Stock and flour in the pot - the Food Core stock line pays off here. Gravy completes biscuits and gravy, bangers and mash, and poutine-grade comfort food.

chain.title: Pancakes
chain.desc: Skillet, oil, batter, butter. The breakfast tier begins: bacon pancakes, chocolate chip pancakes and maple syrup pancakes are each one ingredient past this stack.

chain.title: Waffles
chain.desc: Pancakes plus an egg, mechanically. Waffles feed the legendary chicken-and-waffles plate and the maple syrup waffle - your maple orchard finally meets breakfast.

chain.title: Omelet
chain.desc: Egg, bellpepper and onion in the skillet. Rounds out the breakfast board and slots into the breakfast burrito - eggs stop being a boring food the moment this exists.

chain.title: Stuff Sausages
chain.desc: Any raw meat, salt and spiceleaf on the cutting board. Sausage is a meat-processing hub: bratwurst, sausage rolls, bangers and mash, and breakfast plates all draw from it.

chain.title: Cure Pepperoni
chain.desc: Raw pork and spiceleaf through the grinder. Exists almost entirely to top pizza - which is exactly where this chain goes next.

chain.title: First Pizza
chain.desc: Bakeware, dough, tomato, cheese, pepperoni: the whole Italian supply chain on one stone. Any pizza crafts into 5-8 slices, making it one of the most efficient bulk foods in the pack.

chain.title: The Supreme
chain.desc: Pepperoni pizza plus bellpepper, onion and spiceleaf - eight ingredients, the biggest pizza in the mod. The pizza collection (BBQ chicken, ham and pineapple, meat feast, anchovy) branches from here.

chain.title: Soy Milk
chain.desc: Soybeans in the pot. Opens the soy branch - the mod's alternative protein economy - and substitutes for milk if cows are scarce in your world.

chain.title: Silken Tofu
chain.desc: Soybeans in the saucepan. Soft tofu for soups and desserts, and the direct precursor of firm tofu - the block the whole meatless line is carved from.

chain.title: Press Firm Tofu
chain.desc: Silken tofu under the roller. Firm tofu shapes into tofu 'chicken', 'bacon', 'steak', 'fish', 'mutton' and 'rabbit' - a complete parallel meat supply grown from beans.

chain.title: Brew Soy Sauce
chain.desc: Soybeans in the juicer. The east-Asian recipe line runs on this condiment - teriyaki, stir fry and the tofu meats all require it. Third soybean product, third different tool.

chain.title: Roll Sushi
chain.desc: Raw fish, kelp and rice on the cutting board. Rice from soggy gardens meets the ocean - and sushi is a required component of the Bento Box a few steps ahead.

chain.title: Teriyaki Chicken
chain.desc: Chicken, rice, your soy sauce, honey, scallion and oil in the skillet - six systems converging. Also a Bento Box component; you are building toward a boxed masterpiece.

chain.title: Bamboo Steamed Rice
chain.desc: Rice and bamboo through the grinder. The third Bento component - jungle bamboo finally has a culinary use.

chain.title: The Bento Box
chain.desc: Steamed rice, pickled beets from Food Core, teriyaki chicken and sushi assembled on the cutting board. A four-recipe-deep boxed lunch that touches gardens, oceans, bees and both Pam food mods.

chain.title: Blend Curry Powder
chain.desc: Spiceleaf, mustard seeds and your ground cinnamon in the grinder. This spice blend is the sole gate into the curry tier - the deepest recipe ladder in the mod.

chain.title: Naan
chain.desc: Dough, yogurt and oil on the skillet. Flatbread worth making on its own, but it is also a required side for the deluxe curry - bake a few ahead.

chain.title: Mango Chutney
chain.desc: Mango, spiceleaf, mustard seeds and oil in the pot - your fruit-tree orchard reports for duty. The final side dish standing between you and the deluxe curry.

chain.title: Chicken Curry
chain.desc: Coconut, yogurt, chicken, curry powder, chilipepper and rice in the pot. Six ingredients from four different mods in one dish - the curry itself is already a trophy.

chain.title: The Deluxe Curry
chain.desc: Chicken curry, rice, naan and mango chutney plated on the cutting board. Five recipes deep, spanning gardens, orchards, dairy and spice trade - the true capstone of the HarvestCraft kitchen.

notes: Verified against pamhc2foodextended-1.20.4-1.0.1.jar found in the GayChaseyPacxk instance: 871 item lang keys, 887 recipe files; every chain/collection id checked against the lang file and its recipe read directly. This mod is pure recipes - zero blocks, zero worldgen - and consumes the forge:tool_* tags from pamhc2foodcore plus crop/fruit tags fed by pamhc2crops and pamhc2trees, so its chain should be ordered AFTER those three mods' early steps in any pack. The chain is built as converging ladders: condiments/spices (ketchup, black pepper, ground cinnamon - all one-step grinder/juicer recipes on farmed goods), Tex-Mex (cornmeal -> tortilla -> salsa -> taco), comfort/breakfast (biscuit, gravy, pancakes, waffles, omelet), Italian (sausage -> pepperoni -> pepperoni pizza -> supreme; pizzas slice 5-8x), the soybean tree (soymilk/silken tofu/soy sauce are pot/saucepan/juicer on the same bean; firm tofu shapes into six imitation meats), the Japanese ladder (sushi + teriyaki + bamboo rice -> bentoboxitem, which literally requires pamhc2foodcore:pickledbeetsitem), and the curry ladder ending at deluxechickencurryitem (chickencurry + naan + mangochutney), the deepest craft in the suite. Showpiece collection hubs on epicbltitem, which requires pamhc2foodcore:epicbaconitem. Jelly/juice/smoothie/pie/yogurt exist for ~40 fruits each following one pattern - only the cherry-through-cantaloupe jelly slice is listed to represent them.
